candidates.direct_effect: The proposal would prohibit a covered public college from charging a qualifying resident of one of the four named territories more tuition or fees than it charges residents of the state where the college is located.

exact_action_boundary.proposal_effect: The proposal would prohibit a covered public college from charging a qualifying resident of one of the four named territories more tuition or fees than it charges residents of the state where the college is located.

limitations: Eligibility is limited to the territorial residents and U.S. nationals defined by the bill and to public institutions receiving assistance under the Higher Education Act.

mechanism.description: A Higher Education Act requirement limiting tuition and fees charged by assisted public institutions.

candidates.plain_language_meaning: Qualifying U.S. nationals from Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa, and the U.S. Virgin Islands would receive in-state tuition and fee rates at covered public colleges.
candidates.policy_choice: Whether to require public colleges receiving Higher Education Act assistance to charge qualifying U.S. nationals who reside in specified territories no more than the in-state tuition and fee rate.
